scenario: [LCAP.2.10] / [LDIA.3.3.7]: only a line setting a deferred capability `true` is refused. Lines restating all four storage and samples-plane capabilities `false` are permitted and change nothing (`default` already sets them `false`, [LDIA.9.2]), so the program compiles; a compiler that refuses any line naming one of them reports DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DEFERRED instead. PATH PINNED: the [LCAP.2.10] arm of the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect`, the arm that admits a `false` line.
rules_ds:
use default:
    sampled_slots: false
    persist_on_series: false
    storage_hydrate_facts: false
    storage_hydrate_samples: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
